examples.text: The riots stopped when police moved in.

examples.text: The sight of the armed men stopped him in his tracks.

examples.text: One of the wrestlers suddenly stopped fighting.

glosses: To cause (something) to come to an end.

examples.text: The referees stopped the fight.

glosses: To interrupt, prevent or end the activity of someone or something.

examples.text: Don't let me stop you working.

glosses: To close or block an opening.

examples.text: He stopped the wound with gauze.

glosses: To adjust the aperture of a camera lens.

examples.text: To achieve maximum depth of field, he stopped down to an f-stop of 22.

A symbol used for purposes of punctuation and representing a pause or separating clauses, particularly a full stop, comma, colon or semicolon.

examples.text: The organ is loudest when all the stops are pulled.
